title: BPKD: Boundary Privileged Knowledge Distillation For Semantic Segmentation
mechanism: Distil edge regions and body regions with separate losses, giving edges extra spatially sensitive supervision.
adaptation: Edge mask = crack GT dilated 2 px plus inactive borders; body = rest; up-weight edge term inside the ensemble KD arm.
min_experiment: Arm: Noothout KD arm with BPKD loss. Baseline: Noothout KD arm. Metric: crack IoU, relF1@2. Kill: < +0.008 crack IoU.
evidence: R: state-of-the-art KD on three segmentation benchmarks, CNN and transformer students.
